test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six characters A, B, C, 1, 2 and 3 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the character on the face opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6260d9b3c778d9a3726b11d621ba0c828788160ce4e9dd87c14741e397886b9d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

If two dice have the same face value then their clockwise/anticlockwise surfaces is known as opposite number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de7cfc13a8e0b634f5c16653b30ad10b3367343e6da5e15b530a25bf69a5ca3e.png] 

Here, A is the common surface,

And, 2 and B is the opposite surface,

3 and C is the opposite surface.

So, '3' is opposite to 'C'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
